name: Eagle 1000A Pallet Stretch Wrapper with Manual Pre-Stretch & Ramp
description: The Eagle 1000A semi-auto stretch wrapper is an entry level stretch wrapper for small to medium pallet wrapping needs. This machine does great when wrapping a small volume daily. It comes standard with a height sensor that detects the height of each pallet being wrapped, so the machine knows where to start wrapping. What really keeps the cost down on this machine is the manual pre-stretch carriage. This means that you manually set the tension at which the machine stretches your machine grade stretch wrap to wrap your pallets. A pallet jack loading ramp comes standard with the machine. The turntable can wrap loads with a max diameter of 59 inches, a max height of 87 inches, and a max weight of 3,500 pounds. Backed by a 3 year parts warranty.
